items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: I remember Captain Cool and so forth like that. Several boys that played with him.

ctx.x: You didn't ever play on the boats?

Nope, I never had played on the boats. I remember Captain Cool and so forth like that. Several boys that played with him. But I wasn't too much on traveling. I would go in one day and come back. I wasn't the only one to stay away too long. I've had the opportunity to stay away, but I didn't want to stay away. Yeah, I always did like home. But if I would have left, when I should have left, what I know, everybody that wanted me, I would have made what I wanted to make. But by staying, well, I was a homely fellow.…
I think that's a good idea. Jimmy Clayton was telling us some of the hazards of traveling a few weeks ago. Did you ever play at Milenburg or any of those places in town?
